name: SNLI-VE: Visual Entailment Benchmark
description: SNLI-VE (Visual Entailment) is a multimodal reasoning benchmark adapting the Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) corpus to visual entailment, pairing Flickr30k images as premises with natural language hypotheses across 565,286 pairs labeled as Entailment, Neutral, or Contradiction.

license.name: MIT License / CC-BY-SA 4.0 / Flickr Terms
license.notes: SNLI-VE dataset annotations are released under the MIT License; underlying SNLI annotations are licensed under CC-BY-SA 4.0 and image premises originate from Flickr30k subject to Flickr user licenses.

source_references.title: Visual Entailment: A Novel Task for Fine-Grained Image-Text Reasoning
source_references.notes: Foundational paper establishing the Visual Entailment task.

verification.notes: Verified against arXiv publication (DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1901.06706) and official NEC Laboratories release. Total 565,286 image-hypothesis pairs (train: 529,527, dev: 17,858, test: 17,901) based on 31,783 Flickr30k images.

size.notes: JSONL/text annotation splits (premise images retrieved separately via Flickr30k).
